scenarios.state_policy: Historical named qpos/qvel loaded by initialize.family; new MjData resets integrator caches, applied forces, control, time and actuator state. This is NOT an exact historical integrator continuation.
scenarios.actuator_policy: No dynamic activation state (na=0). Reset ctrl/applied forces; first command overwrites direct-tension ctrl.
scenarios.controller_initialization: Production reach_numerical bundled_guess: historical initial tensions only; placeholder states regenerated with current candidate model. Reset observation count, last plan and failure count.

projection.reconstruction: segment mean curvature from principal joint angle / actual cell length; least squares on exactly integrated basis split at knots

available_history.allowed_for_forecast: Source state and configuration only; no historical future values or plans are fed into preview.

scenarios.prospective_outcome: Two recipes starting from this named state with a new .35 s task and controller reset; no such complete scenario/recipe outcome has been evaluated.
scenarios.independence: Two distinct historical states; new scenario/recipe outcomes are prospective, not independent random trials.
